title: MSHvSF CPS-2 to Saturn correspondence database
scope: First Ryu vertical slice and verified reference-media structure

records.semantic_concept: Deterministic Ryu route with a neutral human-controlled target
records.claim: The CPS-2 route reaches Ryu and Ken versus Spider-Man and Captain America with P2 neutral; the matching Saturn route is not captured.
saturn_evidence: Official port boots through title and attract gameplay, but deterministic player input is not established.
records.test: Cold boot both versions and replay a documented input route to the same teams, positions, and neutral target.
records.falsification: The Saturn route cannot reach the same controllable setup or produces a different team or target state.
records.uncertainty: Saturn gameplay route and input timing are missing.
records.avp_lesson: Use a neutral second player for collision tests so AI decisions do not contaminate deterministic evidence.

records.semantic_concept: Idle, forward walk, and jump response
records.claim: The CPS-2 action order and visual anchors are deterministic; Saturn timing and mechanics are unmeasured.
records.test: Replay identical direction edges and compare input-to-state latency, displacement, jump apex, and recovery separately from rendered animation frames.
records.falsification: Any measured timing or trajectory differs outside the declared tolerance.
records.uncertainty: CPS-2 actor addresses and all Saturn measurements remain unmapped.
records.avp_lesson: Keep gameplay timing and presentation-frame count as separate acceptance dimensions.

records.claim: A deterministic CPS-2 normal-attack visual anchor exists; its state, collision, damage, and Saturn counterpart are not decoded.
records.test: Measure startup, active, recovery, collision geometry, damage, hitstop, and audio onset on both systems.
records.falsification: A paired measurement differs and cannot be explained by a documented presentation-only adaptation.
records.uncertainty: The CPS-2 active frame is visual, not yet a proven collision-active state.
records.avp_lesson: Do not infer hitboxes or damage from a visually active pose.

records.semantic_concept: Hadouken command, spawn, travel, collision, damage, and hit reaction
records.claim: The complete CPS-2 visual sequence is captured; internal fields and the Saturn sequence are unresolved.
records.test: Compare command acceptance, spawn delay, projectile velocity, collision frame, damage delta, hitstop, reaction state, and recovery.
records.falsification: The Saturn event order or a measured mechanical value differs outside the declared tolerance.
records.uncertainty: Health, collision, projectile, and actor structures are not identified on either side of the pair.
records.avp_lesson: A projectile test is a compact probe of input parsing, entity creation, collision, damage, reactions, rendering, and sound.

records.claim: CPS-2 QSound bus activity is synchronized to the slice, while event-to-voice semantics and Saturn SCSP/CDDA responsibility are unresolved.
cps2_evidence: normal and Hadouken windows in data/mshvsf_cps2_vertical_slice.json
saturn_evidence: Disc contains one data track and eleven audio tracks.
records.test: Mute or trace one event at a time and map command, sample/stream source, voice allocation, onset frame, and duration on both systems.
records.falsification: The proposed event mapping fails under isolated replay or routes through a different audio source.
records.uncertainty: File extensions and track types do not prove which assets serve the vertical slice.
records.avp_lesson: Treat audio transport, event semantics, and perceived timing as three separate mappings.

records.claim: The unchanged Saturn BIN boots when a temporary cue points to it and a 32 Mbit expansion cartridge is configured.
cps2_evidence: MAME 0.289 audit passes through a temporary hard-link ROM overlay.
saturn_evidence: Boot header product T-1238G, version V1.000, date 19980903
Yaba Sanshiro 2 v1.20.37 reaches legal screen, title, and attract gameplay
414 ISO files and 12 cue tracks recorded in data/mshvsf_saturn_disc_manifest.json
records.test: Cold boot from temporary overlays while hashing and leaving every source-media file unchanged.
records.falsification: A source file changes, audit fails, or the Saturn runtime does not reach attract gameplay.
records.uncertainty: The successful 4 MB configuration does not by itself prove the exact runtime allocation or failure behavior without the cartridge.
records.avp_lesson: Separate source-media defects from runtime fidelity by using disposable loader overlays.

promotion_rule: No UNRESOLVED gameplay record may be reclassified until the Saturn route has deterministic input, paired measurements, and a falsification replay.
